November 8, 2026

ICE detains eight-year-old San Diego boy at immigration appointment

tags: immigration, politics
sources: @aaronparnas

A Haitian third grader from Fay Elementary in San Diego was taken into custody after a letter summoned him to meet an immigration officer, according to USA Today. His uncle, who had cared for him since the boy's father was deported more than a year ago, brought him to the appointment and left without him. ICE said that out of an abundance of caution it was best to remove the child from the household and place him with the Office of Refugee Resettlement. The boy, who has not been named, is now in the federal shelter system for migrant children.

Nvidia board investigates CEO Jensen Huang over affair with suspected Chinese operative

tags: tech, legal
sources: @aaronparnas, @hunteralexanderhowell, @groundnews

Nvidia's board has opened an independent inquiry after reports linked chief executive Jensen Huang to a woman US intelligence officials believe worked for China's Ministry of State Security. The New York Times reported that Alice Huang, a Chinese businesswoman, was recruited to seek information and press for Nvidia chips to be made available in China. Huang acknowledged in a statement that he was unfaithful to his wife, pledged to cooperate and plans to remain chief executive. The board said it has no evidence of a breach involving company secrets or US national security.

Trump signals shift on deportations in 60 Minutes interview after midterm losses

tags: politics, immigration
sources: @aaronparnas

In a 60 Minutes interview following Democratic midterm gains, Trump said his deportation policy had been too tough and indicated willingness to work on amnesty for certain undocumented immigrants. He was pressed on corruption questions and his World Liberty Financial crypto dealings, and said he could stop insulting Democrats in order to reach deals. He also told the interviewer that anyone invested in the stock market would have seen their net worth rise by $3 billion as his had, and said he hoped he was going to heaven and did not want to go to hell. He suggested he might be better off not endorsing candidates in 2028.

Massie says he has the signatures to force a vote on Epstein Files Transparency Act 2.0

tags: politics, legal
sources: @hunteralexanderhowell

Representative Thomas Massie says he has collected enough signatures to force a floor vote on a second Epstein Files Transparency Act. The measure would differ from the earlier legislation he led by releasing all unredacted material to survivors, who could then share it publicly. Massie is a Republican and will not remain in Congress much longer.

Impeachment push against Hegseth over Iran strikes as House returns

tags: politics, defence
sources: @hunteralexanderhowell, @total.hypocrisy, @aaronparnas

Representative Thomas Massie is leading an effort to impeach Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth over military action against Iran taken without congressional authorization, on the grounds that Congress holds the sole power to declare war. The House returns to session on Monday 9 November under its existing Republican majority, with the newly elected members not sworn in until January. Incoming Democratic congressman Richard Ojeda said he intends to hold Hegseth and Tom Homan accountable. The current Congress has roughly 20 session days remaining and a bill pass rate of one to three percent.

Trump posts video depicting journalists being attacked in the briefing room

tags: politics, media
sources: @aaronparnas

Trump posted a video on Truth Social showing Dana White and UFC fighters taking down journalists in the White House press briefing room after they asked whether he is a threat to democracy. The video mocks reporters who describe the administration as fascist. The post drew comparisons to the treatment of journalists who question power in authoritarian states.

Republican senator alleges rampant corruption as White House aide resigns

tags: politics
sources: @aaronparnas, @oafnation_actual

Senator Ron Johnson said on Fox News that there is rampant corruption within the Trump administration, referring specifically to the MAHA-related movement. White House Deputy Chief of Staff Richard Walters has resigned, Axios reported, the first major departure as Stephen Miller takes charge. Several House members have called for Trump to fire Miller.

BLM rule would fast-track Western Arctic drilling as comment period closes

tags: climate, politics
sources: @carolinegleich

The Bureau of Land Management is proposing a rule, built on a petition from the Alaska Oil and Gas Association, that would approve new drilling sites in the Western Arctic in as little as 60 days without project-by-project environmental review. Any site within 25 miles of existing oil infrastructure would qualify, including infrastructure built under the rule itself, which the BLM describes as producing a gradual westward progression of development. The Western Arctic covers 23 million acres and is habitat for caribou, polar bears and migratory birds, as well as the homeland of Iñupiat communities. The public comment period closes on 9 November.

G7 allies to probe US stance on Ukraine and Middle East after midterms

tags: politics, defence
sources: @oafnation_actual

G7 allies will use Monday talks in Paris to assess whether Trump's midterm defeat changes US policy on Ukraine and the Middle East, Reuters reported. Diplomats said shortages of Patriot air defence systems are Kyiv's most urgent gap. Ukraine tops the agenda ahead of further talks in Abu Dhabi on Tuesday.

Texas children's hospital opens detransition clinic under $10M Paxton settlement

tags: health, legal
sources: @groundnews

Texas Children's Hospital in Houston has opened a detransition clinic as part of a settlement with Attorney General Ken Paxton. The hospital agreed to pay $10 million over allegations it submitted false bills to government programs and private insurers to secure coverage for gender-transition treatments. The settlement requires five years of free detransition treatment and bars transition services for minors. The clinic offers hormone management, surgery, mental health support and fertility counseling through age 21.

Vance allies float Senate or governor run as his standing falls

tags: politics
sources: @aaronparnas

Allies of Vice President J.D. Vance have urged him to consider running for the Senate again or for governor of Ohio rather than the presidency, according to the Wall Street Journal. Vance is said to have been privately humiliated by the suggestions and rejected both. His attempts to distance himself from Trump have not improved his standing, and his unpopularity continues to rise.

Trump-themed bills set to die after Democratic congressional wins

tags: politics
sources: @aaronparnas

A set of bills favored by Trump are expected to fail in the House and Senate following Democratic victories, according to reporting by Scott McFarland. They include adding Trump to Mount Rushmore, renaming Dulles airport after him, declaring his birthday a holiday, issuing a $250 bill with his image, and ordering an NIH study on Trump derangement syndrome.

Trump says Dana White press secretary offer was a joke

tags: politics, media
sources: @oafnation_actual

Trump told reporters on Sunday that he was only kidding about making Dana White White House press secretary, describing the offer as just a little fun. The remark came as households face inflation attributed to the war in Iran and tariffs imposed on US allies. Separately, a different Dana White, a former Pentagon press official, posted that congratulatory messages had been sent to the wrong person and wished the next press secretary luck.

Jay Rockefeller, former West Virginia governor and senator, dies at 89

tags: politics
sources: @groundnews

Jay Rockefeller, a Democrat who served eight years as governor of West Virginia and three decades in the US Senate, has died at 89 at his Washington residence. An heir to the Rockefeller fortune, he arrived in West Virginia in 1964 through an anti-poverty effort and broke with his family's Republican allegiance, winning the governorship in 1976 and a Senate seat in 1984. His legislative record includes a 1997 law establishing health coverage for children in families earning above the Medicaid eligibility threshold. He retired from the Senate in 2015.

McConnell gives no response to questions on Republican midterm losses

tags: politics
sources: @aaronparnas

Mitch McConnell did not answer when a Newsmax reporter on Capitol Hill asked for his reaction to the Republican midterm losses and whether the Senate would accomplish anything in the lame duck session. He will remain a senator for about two more months and is due to vote on pending measures, which could include the impeachment of Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth and permitting reform. Congress is expected to be in session for roughly 20 days in that period.

Microplastics may be changing the color of the Pacific Ocean

tags: climate, environment
sources: @groundnews

Researchers at Norway's University of Bergen report in Communications Earth & Environment that microplastic pollution may explain a shift toward cyan in waters between California and Hawaii. Satellite observations from 2002 to 2022 showed stronger blue and green signals around the Great Pacific Garbage Patch than in neighboring waters, and models including plastics explained the shift better than changes in marine organisms. Measurements at sea are still needed to establish causation, which could yield a satellite method for tracking particles that are otherwise difficult to measure.
